evals.name: summarize-latest
evals.prompt: Summarize the latest article in my Earmark library.
evals.expected_output: Fetches the cloud library, picks the LAST article in the list, and summarizes its actual text, naming its title and source.
assertions: Actually fetched the live library: the answer names a real article title from the cloud copy, not a guess or a refusal
Picked the newest article: the article summarized is the LAST one in the library's list
Summary is grounded in the article's real text: it contains concrete details consistent with that article's content, not generic filler
No dead-end: the answer does not ask the user what Earmark is, ask for a link, or say it has no access to the library

evals.name: unplayed-queue
evals.prompt: What's still unplayed in my earmark queue?
evals.expected_output: Fetches the library and lists exactly the articles with played:false, in order, by title.
assertions: Lists the unplayed articles: every unplayed title in the library appears in the answer
No false positives: no played article is listed as unplayed
No dead-end: the answer does not ask the user what Earmark is, ask for a link, or say it has no access to the library

evals.name: saved-article-question
evals.prompt: I saved an article about running 1,000 AI agents overnight — what did it actually say? Give me the gist.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this refers to the saved reading library even though 'Earmark' isn't named, finds the matching article, and answers from its real text.
assertions: Found the saved article: the answer identifies the matching article from the library even though 'Earmark' was never named
Gist is grounded: the answer relays concrete points consistent with that article's actual text, not generic speculation about the topic
No dead-end: the answer does not ask the user to paste the article, say it can't find it, or answer purely from general knowledge without the library
